nutrients.name: Iron
nutrients.subtitle: Hemoglobin & Cellular Oxygenation
nutrients.prevalence_india: Over 53% of women (NFHS-5) and 25% of men in India are affected by Iron Deficiency Anemia due to phytate-rich cereal diets and low bioavailable heme iron intake.
nutrients.description: Essential for producing hemoglobin, which carries oxygen in red blood cells across your body.

symptoms.name: Fatigue & Low Energy
symptoms.clinical_description: Generalized lethargy and persistent exhaustion due to impaired tissue oxygenation.

symptoms.name: Pale Skin & Conjunctiva (Pallor)
symptoms.clinical_description: Paleness on inner eyelids, face, tongue, and nail beds from reduced hemoglobin.

symptoms.name: Brittle or Spoon-shaped Nails
symptoms.clinical_description: Koilonychia or weak, easily cracked and concave fingernails.

symptoms.name: Excessive Hair Shedding & Loss
symptoms.clinical_description: Telogen effluvium resulting from inadequate ferritin supply to hair follicle matrix.

symptoms.name: Breathlessness on Mild Exertion
symptoms.clinical_description: Dyspnea during routine walking or stairs due to reduced red blood cell oxygen carrying capacity.

nutrients.name: Vitamin B12
nutrients.subtitle: Cobalamin — Nerve & DNA Synthesis
nutrients.prevalence_india: Prevalent in up to 70% of Indian adults, primarily because Vitamin B12 is synthesized exclusively by bacteria and present naturally only in animal-derived foods, while the majority follow vegetarian diets.
nutrients.description: Crucial for myelin sheath maintenance, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell maturation.

symptoms.name: Tingling / Numbness (Pins & Needles)
symptoms.clinical_description: Peripheral neuropathy and paresthesia in hands and feet due to demyelination.

symptoms.name: Memory Issues & Brain Fog
symptoms.clinical_description: Cognitive slowing, forgetfulness, and confusion related to cerebral metabolic decline.

symptoms.name: Deep Physical & Mental Fatigue
symptoms.clinical_description: Macrocytic (megaloblastic) anemia causing persistent systemic tiredness.

symptoms.name: Mood Changes & Irritability
symptoms.clinical_description: Depression, emotional lability, and irritability due to impaired monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis.

symptoms.name: Smooth Red Tongue (Glossitis) & Soreness
symptoms.clinical_description: Inflammation of lingual papillae making the tongue beefy-red and painful.

nutrients.name: Vitamin D
nutrients.subtitle: Cholecalciferol — Bone & Immune Regulator
nutrients.prevalence_india: Affects 70–90% of Indians across all socioeconomic strata due to melanin skin pigmentation blocking UV-B absorption, indoor sedentary routines, and extensive clothing cover.
nutrients.description: Regulates calcium-phosphorus homeostasis, bone mineral density, and immune defense genes.

symptoms.name: Bone & Lower Back Aches
symptoms.clinical_description: Deep, aching bone discomfort and osteomalacic tenderness over the sternum and spine.

symptoms.name: Proximal Muscle Weakness
symptoms.clinical_description: Difficulty rising from a chair or climbing stairs due to reduced type II muscle fiber function.

symptoms.name: Frequent Colds & Respiratory Infections
symptoms.clinical_description: Blunted cathelicidin and defensin production, weakening mucosal antibacterial defenses.

symptoms.name: Low Mood & Seasonal Blues
symptoms.clinical_description: Affective disturbances linked to Vitamin D receptor downregulation in the brain.

symptoms.name: Persistent Unexplained Fatigue
symptoms.clinical_description: Chronic daily fatigue despite adequate sleep, linked to suboptimal cellular oxidative phosphorylation.

nutrients.name: Calcium
nutrients.subtitle: Skeletal Density & Neuromuscular Signaling
nutrients.prevalence_india: Mean dietary calcium intake in India is under 400 mg/day (less than half the ICMR recommended 1000 mg/day) due to low dairy/greens diversity and high phytate/oxalate bindings.
nutrients.description: Structural foundation for bones and teeth, essential for muscle contraction and cardiac rhythm.

symptoms.name: Muscle Spasms & Nocturnal Calf Cramps
symptoms.clinical_description: Hypocalcemic neuromuscular excitability causing sudden tetany, twitches, and cramps.

symptoms.name: Weak, Brittle & Peeling Nails
symptoms.clinical_description: Suboptimal calcium incorporation into keratinized matrix causing fragile nails.

symptoms.name: Dental Weakness & Fragile Enamel
symptoms.clinical_description: Enamel hypomineralization, tooth decay, and brittle dentin.

symptoms.name: Bone Density Loss & Frequent Sprains/Fractures
symptoms.clinical_description: Progressive osteopenia/osteoporosis increasing vulnerability to low-impact fractures.

symptoms.name: Numbness & Tingling in Fingers/Toes
symptoms.clinical_description: Paresthesias around perioral and distal extremities from altered nerve resting potentials.

nutrients.name: Zinc
nutrients.subtitle: Cellular Immunity & Tissue Regeneration
nutrients.prevalence_india: Estimated 40–50% of the Indian population has marginal zinc status due to high cereal-to-meat ratios and excessive phytic acid inhibiting intestinal zinc bioavailability.
nutrients.description: Cofactor for over 300 metalloenzymes controlling cell division, immune defense, and protein synthesis.

symptoms.name: Slow Healing of Cuts & Bruises
symptoms.clinical_description: Impaired fibroblast proliferation and collagen synthesis delaying skin epithelialization.

symptoms.name: Loss or Alteration of Taste / Smell
symptoms.clinical_description: Dysgeusia and hypogeusia caused by low gustin (carbonic anhydrase VI) enzyme activity.

symptoms.name: Diffuse Hair Thinning & Dry Scalp
symptoms.clinical_description: Disrupted follicle mitosis and sebaceous gland regulation causing thinning hair strands.

symptoms.name: Low Immunity & Recurrent Colds
symptoms.clinical_description: Decreased T-lymphocyte maturation and natural killer cell activity against common pathogens.

symptoms.name: Dry Skin Patches & Acne Lesions
symptoms.clinical_description: Acrodermatitis-like dermatitis and impaired epidermal barrier function.

nutrients.name: Folate (Vitamin B9)
nutrients.subtitle: Cell Division, Methylation & Erythropoiesis
nutrients.prevalence_india: High prevalence among women and youth (30–45%) exacerbated by prolonged high-heat cooking of green vegetables and low fresh salad/citrus intake.
nutrients.description: Essential for one-carbon metabolism, DNA replication, neural tube integrity, and RBC production.

symptoms.name: General Weakness & Chronic Fatigue
symptoms.clinical_description: Megaloblastic anemia with enlarged, inefficient erythroblasts reducing oxygen capacity.

symptoms.name: Recurrent Mouth Ulcers & Sore Gums
symptoms.clinical_description: Stomatitis and shallow mucosal erosions due to rapid epithelial turnover failure.

symptoms.name: Poor Concentration & Mental Sluggishness
symptoms.clinical_description: Impaired cerebral folate pathways affecting alertness and processing speed.

symptoms.name: Pale Skin & Subicteric Sclera
symptoms.clinical_description: Ineffective erythropoiesis resulting in mild lemon-yellow pallor.

symptoms.name: Exertional Breathlessness & Dizziness
symptoms.clinical_description: Cardiovascular compensation for reduced circulating red blood cell volume.

nutrients.name: Vitamin A
nutrients.subtitle: Retinol — Vision, Epithelial Barrier & Immunity
nutrients.prevalence_india: Historically endemic in India (~30–40% subclinical deficiency in vulnerable groups), driven by inadequate dietary beta-carotene conversion and low dietary fat co-ingestion.
nutrients.description: Vital for rhodopsin formation for night vision, mucosal epithelium lining, and antibody response.

symptoms.name: Difficulty Seeing in Dim Light (Nyctalopia)
symptoms.clinical_description: Delayed dark adaptation due to depleted rod photoreceptor rhodopsin photopigment.

symptoms.name: Dry, Itchy Eyes & Bitot's Spots
symptoms.clinical_description: Xerophthalmia caused by conjunctival goblet cell loss and keratinization of the ocular surface.

symptoms.name: Frequent Respiratory & Gastrointestinal Bugs
symptoms.clinical_description: Epithelial integrity breakdown in the respiratory and gut tracts allowing pathogen entry.

symptoms.name: Dry, Scaly Skin (Follicular Hyperkeratosis)
symptoms.clinical_description: Keratin plugging around hair follicles resulting in rough 'goosebump' skin texture.

symptoms.name: Delayed Epithelial Healing
symptoms.clinical_description: Slower regeneration of cutaneous layers after superficial injuries.
